routes.title: Translate your app without breaking it — JSON Link
routes.description: Open JSON, Flutter ARB, Android XML, iOS .strings, Excel, or CSV in one browser spreadsheet. Placeholders like {count} and %1$s stay locked as chips.
routes.h1: Translate your app without breaking it.
routes.lede: Open JSON, Flutter ARB, Android XML, iOS .strings, Excel or CSV in one spreadsheet. Placeholders like {count} and %1$s stay locked as chips, and the linter flags translations, including AI, that drop them. Runs in your browser; your files never leave it.

routes.title: About JSON Link — in-browser translation spreadsheet
routes.description: JSON Link is a free open-source spreadsheet for app locale files. It runs in your browser, checks placeholders, and does not store your files on a server.
routes.h1: The Private Localization Workspace for Developers & Translators
routes.lede: Link, edit, and export locale files in a spreadsheet that stays in your browser.

routes.title: Docs — JSON Link translation spreadsheet
routes.description: Import JSON, Flutter ARB, Android XML, iOS .strings, Excel, or CSV, edit them in the spreadsheet, and export without dropping placeholders like {count} or %1$s.
routes.lede: How to open locale files, edit translations, and export them from the JSON Link spreadsheet.

routes.title: Privacy Policy — JSON Link
routes.description: JSON Link edits locale files in your browser. Files are not uploaded to a JSON Link server. AI translation and GitHub sync run only if you turn them on.
routes.lede: Locale files are parsed and edited in your browser. JSON Link does not store them on a server.

routes.title: Terms of Service — JSON Link
routes.description: Terms for the JSON Link web app, the create-jsonlink starter, the Vite plugin, and the @jsonlink/mcp server.
routes.lede: Terms for using the JSON Link web app and its open-source packages.

routes.title: Cookie and Storage Policy — JSON Link
routes.description: JSON Link does not use tracking cookies. Drafts and settings stay in this browser through localStorage and IndexedDB.
routes.lede: JSON Link does not use tracking cookies. Settings and drafts stay in this browser.

routes.title: Page not found — JSON Link
routes.description: That URL is not a JSON Link page. Open the translation spreadsheet, the docs, or the about page.
routes.lede: This page does not exist. Your locale files stay in the browser on the pages that do.
